title: Shimon of Kitron
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Mekhilta, Beshalach, Massekhta deVayehi, chapter 3: he said, “By the merit of Joseph’s bones I will split the sea.” It is also cited in Bereshit Rabbah 87:8.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Bereshit Rabbah 87:8 attributes to Shimon of Kitron the passive statement that the sea was split for Israel through the merit of Joseph’s bones. Hyman’s Mekhilta quotation uses “I will split”; it is preserved as the wording he quotes, not a claim that Shimon himself split the sea.

The whole consulted Midrash Rabbah — TE Bereshit Rabbah 87:8 names Shimon of Kitron and says passively that the sea was split for Israel through Joseph’s bones. Hyman’s separately attributed Mekhilta quotation retains “I will split”; it is quoted wording, not a new assertion that Shimon himself split the sea. The named Mekhilta passage has not been freshly collated here, and no additional episode is imported.
